subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should Talk gateway-relay audio formally accept only standard base64, or preserve any previously tolerated base64url-style input while rejecting genuinely malformed frames?
rationale: The patch intentionally narrows input accepted by current main, and tests alone cannot determine whether that compatibility break matches the intended Talk relay contract.

options.title: Adopt standard-base64-only
options.body: Confirm standard base64 as the wire contract, keep base64url rejection, and require real configured proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve compatible variants
options.body: Adjust the decoder to accept supported base64 variants while still rejecting junk input, with regression tests defining the retained compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt standard-base64-only
recommendation.body: Confirm standard base64 as the wire contract, keep base64url rejection, and require real configured proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: VACInc was routed into the affected Talk/Gateway review and is the best available candidate to resolve the relay compatibility boundary.
